title: Reward trophy
wikitext:
A [[reward trophy]] is an [[item]] given as a reward for completing certain tasks. They can be traded to [[collector]]s for more valuable items. Reward trophies differ from ordinary [[trophy|trophies]] in several other ways: they cannot be sold to [[merchant]]s, [[salvage]]d, and most do not [[drop]] from [[foe]]s. == Core == === Birthday Present === A Birthday Present Voucher is awarded to each [[character]] every 12 months beginning at 96 months (counting from the day of creation). They can be exchanged for [[Birthday Surprise Box]]es. :{| {{STDT|silver}} |- style="background-color:#FC6;" ! There are a wide variety of items for which they can be exchanged; with the most common use being traded up towards a Envoy Weapon, Equipment Pack, Title points or to obtain an Zaishen Key, which is used as a form of alternative [[currency]]. :{| {{STDT|silver}} |- style="background-color:#FC6;" !
